top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the course of an investigation, it was determined that a caregiver was yelling at children.

top_violation_types.title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At time of inspection an eight month infant was observed with a blanket inside the crib.   This was corrected at inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There is sufficient evidence to support the claim that the school age children play video games for more than an hour while in care.

top_violation_types.title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Re-cite: Documentation of drills was not available for review at the time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness (26 TAC §746.305(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Operation failed to notify Licensing of a reportable illness within the required timeframe.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The ground is splitting open and causing a tripping hazard at the entrance to the playground.       Photos taken

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.
